# appwrite_auth_session (Ephemeral Resource)

Opens a session for an Appwrite user, and deletes it once Terraform is finished. The session secret is never written to Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to open a session for.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `expire` (String) The session expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) The session ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The session secret.
